note: Read by pipeline/aws/r1/final_stage.py (repin, gate2) in the final job (M) and finalb0 (B0). ledger_date: the date the M ledgers are installed under in the scratch tree (data_numbers_<ledger_date>*.json); a date label later than config/r1/final_tree.json current.ledger_date (2026-10-23), so the M ledgers never take an October name (repin refuses LEDGER_DATE_UNSET / LEDGER_DATE_NOT_LATER). finalb0 ignores it and keeps the tree's own date (config/r1/final_tree.json current_b0.ledger_date), so the dated names do not move. words_limit: the author's limit, counted by tools/count_words.py (rule of 2026-09-13). figures: the nine figures install.py exhibits copies (--figures). rearchive: where install.py ledgers moves the tree's dated October ledgers (_archive/<rearchive>/). deliver: copied from $WORK/prod/<from> to /work/out/final/<name> by gate2 (with gate2.json, change_facts.json and tree_r1.tar).
